title: identity.user.created payload
description: The `data` payload of the `identity.user.created` event: a signup completed, before email verification. The envelope is validated by schemas/event-envelope.schema.json; this schema validates what is inside `data`. The file path is the event type with dots as directory separators. See docs/event-naming.md.

user_id.description: The new user. Always equal to the envelope's `subject`, so a consumer can key on either.

email.description: Email address as typed at signup, lowercased and trimmed. Unverified: the verification event is what makes it trustworthy.

email_verified.description: Always false. This event precedes verification; `identity.user.email_verified` is what flips it.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag chosen at signup, e.g. `en` or `en-GB`. Defaults to `en` when the client sent nothing.

account_ids.description: Accounts this user was added to during signup. Usually empty or one entry; an admin-invited user arrives through `identity.member.joined` instead.
